newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ABARE sees record 96/97 Australia rice crop.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ABARE sees record 96/97 Australia rice crop.

text.p: Australian rice production is forecast to be a record 1.46 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July-June), 28 percent above the previous record set two years ago, the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE) said in its latest national Crop Report.
ABARE's latest forecast compares with the previous forecast of 1.45 million tonnes for 1996/97 and compared with 1995/96 output of 951,000 tonnes. The harvest will be in April to June.
"Yields have been boosted by warm conditions in the crucial January-February growing period and are forecast to be above average at 8.8 tonnes a hectare."
Rice production is dominated by growers in the state of New South Wales.
ABARE said the 1996/97 record forecast was based on a record planting of 166,000 hectares, with the Murray Valley district expected to be the largest growing area with 92,000 hectares sown.
About 750 hectares has been planted in the state of Victoria.
